annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: nobody gets hurt if I act, and five might if I don't
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers probably think this is just another shift.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: tell them plainly what nearly happened, and stay while it sinks in
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: so they aren't left alone with it

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The only cost is a train sitting in a siding.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: What weighs on me is those five families
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: One of the workers might feel shaken, even embarrassed, afterward.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want to stay with them a little
annotations.pd_harm_distress: What weighs on me is those five families

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Leaving it means five people possibly dying for nothing
annotations.pda_responsibility: five people possibly dying for nothing, and I'd carry that
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: it feels grim to be the one standing there
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess the crew trusts that the line is shut off.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: report it, so that trust isn't let down again
annotations.pda_repair_intention: find whoever runs the station and report it

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: An empty train into an empty siding costs nothing
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The workers likely want nothing more than to finish up and go home.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Pulling the lever is how I help them do exactly that

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five lives for a hand on a lever is the whole of it
annotations.pd_personal_consequence_anxiety: I'm trusting that, which unsettles me a bit
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: One of the workers might end up feeling it was somehow his fault.
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want him to hear from me, gently, that no one blames him
annotations.pda_responsibility: isn't something I could live with

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: doing nothing risks five people, acting risks none
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: at least one of the workers would be badly rattled
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd walk over and ask if they're all right

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the trade is nothing on one side and five people on the other
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: maybe hoping someone up at the station is paying attention
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I'd want to be that someone

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: picking the worse outcome when the better one costs nothing
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the workers expect their colleagues upstream to keep them safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: wait with them until a supervisor comes

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five lives outweigh a stopped train
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if either were in doubt, I'd feel far less sure
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: has a person at home expecting them for dinner tonight
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: has a person at home expecting them for dinner tonight
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It's a sad thing to have to think about at all.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five people saved, no one harmed
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: some of them would be angry, and quietly so
annotations.ce_supportive_use: offer to go with them to report it, so that anger has somewhere useful
